<style>
/* Job Atlas — a field guide to every job. Specimen plates, running-head header with index tabs, sundial day, salary ladder, subway career path. Tokens only (+ one local module colour). */
:root{
--m1:var(--c-primary);--m2:#b24a6b;--m3:var(--c-accent);--m4:var(--c-secondary);
--ja-card:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-surface) 45%,#fff);
--ja-ink2:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-text) 74%,var(--c-surface));
--ja-ink3:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-text) 52%,var(--c-surface));
--ja-acc-text:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-accent) 62%,var(--c-text));
--ja-shadow:0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 10%,transparent),0 16px 30px -22px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 55%,transparent);
}
body{background:var(--c-surface);background-image:radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 7%,transparent) 1px,transparent 1.2px);background-size:22px 22px}
.ja-i{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;vertical-align:-.22em}
.ja-in{max-width:var(--w,1240px);margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,4vw,44px)}
:focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--c-accent);outline-offset:2px}
.ja-lab{font:700 12px/1.2 var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ja-ink3)}
.ja-zh{font-family:var(--f-body)}

/* ── running head + index tabs ── */
.ja-top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-surface) 92%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
.ja-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;min-height:66px}
.ja-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c-primary);font:600 24px/1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ja-brand .ja-i{width:34px;height:34px;color:var(--c-accent);stroke-width:1.4}
.ja-brand small{font:700 11px/1 var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ja-ink3);margin-left:4px;padding-left:12px;border-left:1.5px solid var(--c-border)}
.ja-head .sp{flex:1}
.ja-find{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);background:var(--ja-card);color:var(--ja-ink2);text-decoration:none;font:600 14px var(--f-body);min-width:min(280px,40vw)}
.ja-find:hover{border-color:var(--c-primary);color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-find kbd{margin-left:auto;font:700 11px var(--f-body);padding:2px 7px;border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:6px}
.ja-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;border-bottom:2px solid var(--c-primary);padding-top:6px}
.ja-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.ja-tab{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c-primary);font:700 14px var(--f-body);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tc,var(--c-primary)) 10%,var(--c-surface));border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-bottom:0;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;transition:background .15s}
.ja-tab i{font:600 12px var(--f-head);width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--tc,var(--c-primary));color:#fff;font-style:normal}
.ja-tab:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tc,var(--c-primary)) 20%,var(--c-surface))}
.ja-tab.on{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);border-color:var(--c-primary);z-index:1}
.ja-tab.on i{background:var(--on-primary);color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-tab.util{margin-left:auto;--tc:var(--c-accent)}
.ja-tab.util+.ja-tab.util{margin-left:0}

/* ── generic ── */
.ja-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:48px;padding:0 24px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary);border:1.5px solid var(--c-primary);font:700 14.5px/1 var(--f-body);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
.ja-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 82%,var(--c-accent))}
.ja-btn.o{background:transparent;color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-btn.o:hover{background:var(--c-primary);color:var(--on-primary)}
.ja-btn.sm{min-height:44px;padding:0 18px;font-size:13.5px}
.ja-sec{padding:clamp(36px,5vw,72px) 0}
.ja-sec.tight{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,40px) 0}
.ja-h2{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:clamp(20px,3vw,34px)}
.ja-h2 h2{font:600 clamp(28px,3.6vw,42px)/1.05 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.015em}
.ja-h2 p{max-width:52ch;color:var(--ja-ink2);font-size:16px}
.ja-h2 .rule{flex:1;min-width:40px;border-bottom:1.5px dashed var(--c-border);height:1px;align-self:center}
.ja-h2 .more{margin-left:auto;font:700 14px var(--f-body);color:var(--c-primary);display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;min-height:44px}
.ja-h2 .more:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.ja-em{width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ja-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:28px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:999px;font:700 12.5px/1 var(--f-body);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc,var(--c-primary)) 12%,var(--c-surface));color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc,var(--c-primary)) 80%,var(--c-text));white-space:nowrap}
.ja-chip.line{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);color:var(--ja-ink2)}

/* ── hero ── */
.ja-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(34px,5vw,76px) 0 clamp(26px,4vw,54px)}
.ja-hero h1{font:600 clamp(40px,6vw,72px)/1.02 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--c-accent);position:relative;white-space:nowrap}
.ja-hero h1 em svg{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-.14em;width:100%;height:.28em;fill:none;stroke:var(--c-accent);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round}
.ja-hero .lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.5vw,19px);color:var(--ja-ink2);max-width:46ch;margin:22px 0 26px;line-height:1.7}
.ja-sbox{position:relative;max-width:560px}
.ja-sbox label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:60px;padding:0 22px;background:var(--ja-card);border:2px solid var(--c-primary);border-radius:999px;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--c-primary)}
.ja-sbox input{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:none;font:600 17px var(--f-body);color:var(--c-text);min-height:48px;outline:none}
.ja-sbox input::placeholder{color:var(--ja-ink3);font-weight:500}
.ja-sbox:focus-within label{border-color:var(--c-accent);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--c-accent)}
.ja-sdrop{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;top:calc(100% + 14px);background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:18px;padding:8px;box-shadow:var(--ja-shadow);z-index:20;display:none;max-height:340px;overflow:auto}
.ja-sbox.open .ja-sdrop{display:block}
.ja-sdrop a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:52px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c-text)}
.ja-sdrop a:hover,.ja-sdrop a:focus-visible{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-accent) 12%,var(--c-surface))}
.ja-sdrop .e{width:38px;height:38px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;padding:7px;color:var(--mc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 12%,var(--c-surface))}
.ja-sdrop b{font:600 16px var(--f-head);display:block}.ja-sdrop small{font:500 12.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--ja-ink2)}
.ja-sdrop .none{padding:14px;color:var(--ja-ink2);font-size:14px}
.ja-hint{margin-top:16px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--ja-ink2)}
.ja-hint a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:36px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:99px;border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);background:var(--ja-card);color:var(--c-primary);text-decoration:none;font-weight:700}
.ja-hint a:hover{border-color:var(--c-accent)}
.ja-drawer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:10px;padding:14px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 92%,#000);border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -30px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 80%,transparent)}
.ja-drawer a{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:16px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-surface) 94%,var(--mc));color:var(--mc);padding:15%;display:block;transition:transform .2s,background .2s;border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 35%,transparent)}
.ja-drawer a:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(8px)}
.ja-drawer a:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-3deg);background:var(--ja-card)}
.ja-drawer a span{position:absolute;left:6px;top:5px;font:700 10px var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ja-ink3)}
@media(max-width:900px){.ja-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ja-drawer{gap:8px;padding:12px}.ja-drawer a:nth-child(even){transform:none}}
@media(max-width:560px){.ja-drawer{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.ja-brand small{display:none}.ja-find{min-width:0;padding:0 14px}.ja-find span{display:none}.ja-find kbd{display:none}}

/* ── specimen plates ── */
.ja-plates{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(236px,1fr));gap:18px}
.ja-plate{--mc:var(--m1);position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:20px 20px 18px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c-text);background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-primary);border-radius:6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ja-card),inset 0 0 0 5px var(--c-border),var(--ja-shadow);transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.ja-plate:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-.4deg);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px var(--ja-card),inset 0 0 0 5px var(--mc),0 22px 34px -24px color-mix(in srgb,var(--c-primary) 70%,transparent)}
.ja-plate .no{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:700 11.5px var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ja-ink3);padding:2px 4px 0}
.ja-plate .em{width:84px;height:84px;margin:4px auto 2px;padding:19px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--mc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 11%,var(--c-surface));border:1.5px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 45%,transparent);outline:1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 40%,transparent);outline-offset:5px;transition:transform .35s}
.ja-plate:hover .em{transform:rotate(14deg)}
.ja-plate h3{font:600 22px/1.12 var(--f-head);text-align:center;color:var(--c-primary);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.ja-plate .zh{display:block;font:500 13px var(--f-body);color:var(--ja-ink2);margin-top:3px}
.ja-plate .ft{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font:700 12.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--ja-ink2);border-top:1px dashed var(--c-border);padding-top:11px;margin-top:auto}
.ja-plate .ft b{color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 78%,var(--c-text))}
.ja-shelf{margin-bottom:clamp(30px,4vw,56px)}
.ja-shelf>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ja-rn{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 22px var(--f-head);color:#fff;background:var(--mc);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--c-surface),0 0 0 5.5px var(--mc);flex:none}
.ja-shelf h3{font:600 clamp(22px,2.6vw,30px)/1.1 var(--f-head);color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-shelf header p{color:var(--ja-ink2);font-size:14.5px;max-width:60ch}
.ja-shelf header .grow{flex:1;min-width:200px}

/* ── role cards / rows ── */
.ja-roles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:16px}
.ja-role{--mc:var(--m1);display:grid;grid-template-columns:56px 1fr;gap:6px 16px;padding:18px 20px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--c-text);background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-left:6px solid var(--mc);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--ja-shadow);transition:transform .15s,border-color .15s}
.ja-role:hover{transform:translateX(3px);border-color:var(--mc)}
.ja-role .e{width:56px;height:56px;padding:12px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--mc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 11%,var(--c-surface));grid-row:span 2;align-self:center}
.ja-role h3{font:600 20px/1.15 var(--f-head);color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-role .meta{font:600 13px var(--f-body);color:var(--ja-ink2);display:flex;gap:6px 12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.ja-role .sal{font:700 14px var(--f-body);color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 78%,var(--c-text))}
.ja-role .cat{font:700 11.5px var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ja-ink3);text-transform:uppercase}
.ja-role[hidden]{display:none}

/* ── dossier ── */
.ja-doc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px minmax(0,1fr) 320px;gap:clamp(20px,3vw,44px);align-items:start;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,40px) 0 64px}
.ja-toc{position:sticky;top:132px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding-right:6px}
.ja-toc .ja-lab{margin-bottom:10px}
.ja-toc a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:40px;padding:0 10px;border-left:3px solid var(--c-border);text-decoration:none;color:var(--ja-ink2);font:700 13.5px var(--f-body);transition:color .15s,border-color .15s,background .15s}
.ja-toc a i{font:600 12px var(--f-head);color:var(--ja-ink3);font-style:normal;width:18px}
.ja-toc a:hover{color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-toc a.on{color:var(--c-primary);border-left-color:var(--mc,var(--c-accent));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc,var(--c-accent)) 9%,transparent)}
.ja-art{min-width:0}
.ja-title{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:clamp(16px,2.6vw,30px);align-items:center;margin-bottom:clamp(26px,3.6vw,46px);padding-bottom:clamp(22px,3vw,34px);border-bottom:2px solid var(--c-primary)}
.ja-title .em{width:clamp(84px,11vw,132px);aspect-ratio:1;padding:22%;border-radius:50%;color:var(--mc);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 11%,var(--c-surface));border:2px solid var(--mc);outline:2px dashed color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 45%,transparent);outline-offset:7px}
.ja-title h1{font:600 clamp(34px,5vw,60px)/1.02 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:8px 0 12px}
.ja-title .one{font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,21px);color:var(--ja-ink2);max-width:52ch;line-height:1.55}
.ja-title .tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
.ja-blk{margin-bottom:clamp(34px,4.4vw,56px);scroll-margin-top:140px}
.ja-blk>h2{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;font:600 clamp(26px,3vw,34px)/1.1 var(--f-head);letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-bottom:18px}
.ja-blk>h2 i{font:600 15px var(--f-body);font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--mc,var(--c-accent));text-transform:uppercase}
.ja-blk p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--c-text);max-width:64ch}
.ja-blk p+p{margin-top:14px}
.ja-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;max-width:64ch}
.ja-list li{position:relative;padding-left:28px;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.65}
.ja-list li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:.62em;width:11px;height:11px;border:2px solid var(--mc,var(--c-accent));border-radius:50% 0 50% 50%;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.ja-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.ja-tools span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-bottom-width:4px;font:700 14px var(--f-body)}
.ja-tools span small{font:500 12.5px var(--f-body);color:var(--ja-ink2)}

/* sundial */
.ja-day{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,340px) 1fr;gap:clamp(18px,3vw,36px);align-items:center}
.ja-dial{width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.ja-dial .arc{fill:none;stroke:var(--c-border);stroke-width:2;stroke-dasharray:2 7;stroke-linecap:round}
.ja-dial .base{stroke:var(--c-primary);stroke-width:2}
.ja-dial .tk{stroke:var(--ja-ink3);stroke-width:1.4}
.ja-dial .sun{fill:var(--c-accent);stroke:var(--c-primary);stroke-width:1.5}
.ja-dial .dot circle{fill:var(--ja-card);stroke:var(--mc);stroke-width:2.2;transition:fill .2s,r .2s}
.ja-dial .dot text{font:700 12px var(--f-body);fill:var(--c-primary);text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central}
.ja-dial .dot.on circle{fill:var(--mc);r:15}.ja-dial .dot.on text{fill:#fff}
.ja-dial .t{font:700 11px var(--f-body);fill:var(--ja-ink3);text-anchor:middle;letter-spacing:.08em}
.ja-times{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.ja-times li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 76px 1fr;gap:8px 12px;align-items:start;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:12px;cursor:default;transition:background .15s;border:1.5px solid transparent}
.ja-times li:hover,.ja-times li.on{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 9%,var(--c-surface));border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 30%,transparent)}
.ja-times li b{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mc);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:700 12px var(--f-body)}
.ja-times li time{font:700 14px var(--f-body);color:var(--c-primary);padding-top:2px;white-space:nowrap}
.ja-times li span{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.55}
@media(max-width:700px){.ja-day{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ja-times li{grid-template-columns:30px 1fr}.ja-times li time{grid-column:2;padding:0}.ja-times li span{grid-column:2}}

/* ladder */
.ja-lad{width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.ja-lad .gl{stroke:var(--c-border);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:3 5}
.ja-lad .bar{fill:color-mix(in srgb,var(--mc) 22%,var(--c-surface));stroke:var(--mc);stroke-width:2}
.ja-lad .bar.top{fill:var(--mc)}
.ja-lad .step{fill:none;stroke:var(--c-primary);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ja-lad text{font-family:var(--f-body);fill:var(--c-text)}
.ja-lad .v{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;text-anchor:middle}
.ja-lad .l{font-weight:700;font-size:12px;text-anchor:middle;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:var(--ja-ink2)}
.ja-lad .s{font-weight:500;font-size:12.5px;text-anchor:middle;fill:var(--ja-ink3)}
.ja-lad .ax{font-size:11px;fill:var(--ja-ink3);font-weight:600}
.ja-factors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
.ja-factors div{background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px}
.ja-factors b{display:block;font:700 12px var(--f-body);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mc);margin-bottom:5px}
.ja-factors span{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ja-ink2)}

/* subway path */
.ja-pathw{overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:8px}
.ja-path{min-width:640px;width:100%;height:auto}
.ja-path .main{stroke:var(--mc);stroke-width:7;stroke-linecap:round;fill:none}
.ja-path .alt{stroke:var(--c-primary);stroke-width:4;stroke-dasharray:1 8;stroke-linecap:round;fill:none}
.ja-path .st{fill:var(--c-surface);stroke:var(--c-primary);stroke-width:4}
.ja-path .stx{fill:var(--c-surface);stroke:var(--c-accent);stroke-width:4}
.ja-path text{font-family:var(--f-body);fill:var(--c-text)}
.ja-path .nm{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;text-anchor:middle}
.ja-path .sb{font-weight:500;font-size:12.5px;text-anchor:middle;fill:var(--ja-ink2)}
.ja-path .xn{font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;text-anchor:start;fill:var(--ja-acc-text)}

/* pros / cons / myth */
.ja-pc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.ja-pc>div{background:var(--ja-card);border:1.5px solid var(--c-border);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px}
.ja-pc h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:600 21px var(--f-head);margin-bottom:12px;color:var(--c-primary)}
.ja-pc h3 .ja-i{width:28px;height:28px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%}

Banking 银行

The business of looking after other people’s money and lending it back out. Plenty of entry doors, a clear ladder, and rules you must follow.

How the field works

Money comes in as deposits, goes out as loans; the gap pays everyone’s salary.

Upstream

Central bank rules, depositors who park savings, and technology vendors who keep the systems running.

The field

Retail, commercial and Islamic banks. Branches take deposits; credit teams decide who can borrow and how much.

Downstream

Households buying homes, small businesses needing working capital, and large companies raising funds.

How a bank makes money

Mostly the gap between the interest it pays on deposits and the interest it charges on loans, plus fees for cards, transfers and advice. That is why the people who judge risk well — credit analysts — sit close to the core of the business.

Roles in this field

Ordered from the front counter to the back office.

What’s changing

  • Branch counters are shrinking as everyday banking moves to apps; teller roles are evolving into advice roles.
  • Risk, compliance and data skills are in short supply, so analysts with Excel and basic SQL stand out.
  • Chartered Banker and credit certificates are the common route from analyst to manager.

Profile no. 0412 · Banking · Tech & Specialised

Credit Analyst 信贷分析员

Decides whether the bank lends the money — by working out how likely it is to come back.

AnalystOffice-basedDegree needed

01A day in the life

  1. 19:00 amOpen a new loan application and pull the applicant’s repayment history from the central credit register.
  2. 210:30 amCross-check the credit bureau score to rate overall risk.
  3. 312:00 pmRead three years of company accounts and work out whether profits can cover the repayments.
  4. 414:00 pmWrite the credit report: approve, decline, or approve with a smaller limit — and say why.
  5. 516:00 pmSpot a number that doesn’t add up, then call the applicant or the relationship manager to clear it.

02What you actually do

  • Review loan and credit applications and the applicant’s financial statements.
  • Judge repayment ability and the chance of default.
  • Write the credit report and recommend approve, decline or adjust.
  • Watch existing borrowers for early warning signs.
  • Agree loan conditions with relationship managers and the risk team.

03Tools of the trade

Central credit register repayment history, 12 monthsCredit bureau report 300–850 scoreBank’s scoring model in-houseExcel ratios & simulations

04What it pays

Monthly salary, in ringgit. The ladder is a range — where you land depends on the three things below.

Bank typeCorporate and commercial lending pays more than personal loans — the cases are harder and the stakes higher.
LocationMost head offices and approval centres sit in the Klang Valley, and pay follows.
CertificatesChartered Banker or a credit-professional certificate is the usual ticket to manager level.

05Getting in

  • Education: a degree in economics, business, finance or accounting.
  • Skills: reading financial statements; a feel for credit risk.
  • Interview: expect a short case — a simplified set of accounts, and you give a yes or no on the spot. Most banks train new hires on their own systems.

06Where it leads

07How it earns its keep

A bank’s biggest risk is lending money that never comes back. Every careful decision here protects the loan book — and a sharp analyst lets the bank lend more, safely.

08Good and not so good

The good

  • Analysis skills transfer to almost any finance job.
  • Pay climbs clearly with seniority.
  • Little pressure to hit sales targets.

The less good

  • A wrong call lands on the bank, and on you.
  • You must keep up with the economy and each industry.
  • Busy periods mean tight turnaround times.

09A common myth

The myth

“It’s just ticking boxes and letting loans through.”

The reality

Numbers are only half of it. You weigh industry trends, how trustworthy management is, and the wider economy — judgement that grows with experience, not a formula.

Method & sources · 方法与来源

How this atlas is made

Every profile follows the same eight-part shape so you can compare roles without re-learning the page. Each is written for a reader who knows nothing about the industry.

  1. Research. Job ads, industry bodies and salary surveys are read first; interviews fill the gaps.
  2. Draft. Plain words, no buzzwords, and real software names instead of “office tools”.
  3. Check. Where a number has no source, we say so rather than guess.
  4. Review & date. Every profile shows when it was last checked.
